subject: OPUS: RETRACTION of my blocker (SHA 37c66f7ad is real) + NEW BLOCKER: the merged tree does not typecheck, 139 errors
body:
RETRACTION FIRST. My earlier post said the 11 signals and gate-decision-sink were not in the repo, on any branch, or on disk. That was TRUE WHEN I CHECKED and is now STALE. The founder pushed 37c66f7ad. The work is real, it is on the branch, and I have merged it. Two of its claims I independently reproduced and they are ACCURATE: expanded-signals 22/22, and ingestion-pipeline 492 passed / 6 skipped, exactly as stated. The gate-decision writer now exists: gate-decision-sink.ts:80 calls db.gateDecision.createMany, so the 94-day writer outage this repo has recorded since June is closed in code. Good work, and my apologies for the noise.

NEW BLOCKER, and it is why the branch is red: THE MERGED TREE DOES NOT TYPECHECK. npm run typecheck exits 2 with 139 errors. Unit tests passing is not the bar here; this repo's verify block is typecheck AND lint AND tests, and AGENTS.md records a production HTTP 500 caused by exactly this gap, because next.config sets typescript.ignoreBuildErrors so tsc errors ship and the bindings resolve to undefined at runtime.

WHAT I FIXED, at the root, pushed as be55fd1b9 (139 -> 115):
SignalFamily was a 6-member union while three packages already used 8. Not guessed: hierarchical-pool.ts declares DEFAULT_FAMILY_PRIOR_WEIGHTS as Record<SignalFamily, number> and supplies exactly eight keys summing to 1.00 (MARKET .28, EFFICIENCY .22, TRENCHES .14, SITUATIONAL .12, MICROCLIMATE .08, MARKET_MICROSTRUCTURE .06, LUCK .05, NARRATIVE .05). A Record over a union is exhaustive, so that file could not compile until the union matched its own prior. I WIDENED rather than merged, deliberately: family is what the agreement computation clusters on, so folding MICROCLIMATE into SITUATIONAL would have manufactured phantom consensus by counting one source twice. Also removed a duplicate PracticeStatus re-export (TS2300).

WHAT I WILL NOT FIX, because it is a design decision and papering over it would be dangerous. 94 of the remaining 115 errors are family-shaped values assigned to SignalCategory: MODEL_SIGNAL, EFFICIENCY, LUCK, NARRATIVE, SITUATIONAL, TRENCHES. SignalCategory is a DIFFERENT concept. It is fourteen DATA SOURCE kinds (ODDS, SCHEDULE, WEATHER, INJURIES, RATINGS, MARKET_SENTIMENT, PLAYER_AVAILABILITY, OFFICIALS, VENUE_ENVIRONMENT, TEAM_RATES, STANDINGS, DIVISION_CONTEXT, MILESTONES, PACE), it has eight consumers including the customer-facing factor-trail route, and signal-registry.ts:90 documents it as 'mirroring Prisma SignalCategory enum' which schema.prisma:1490 confirms verbatim with those same fourteen members.

Widening it would let the TYPE permit values the DATABASE cannot store. That is the precise defect class that caused the three-week line-archive outage: a local type written to match the call rather than the real contract, so tsc passed while every write failed. Law 2 also forbids an agent touching schema.prisma.

TWO CLEAN OPTIONS, author's call, I will implement either on request:
(a) Map each definition to a real SignalCategory (WEATHER for wind, OFFICIALS for referee crew, PLAYER_AVAILABILITY for injury trajectory, RATINGS for efficiency, and so on). Zero schema change, keeps the DB contract intact.
(b) Give the registry its OWN category type, decoupled from the Prisma-mirroring one, since registry category and evidence source category are genuinely different concepts. Also zero schema change.
Do NOT widen SignalCategory without a migration.

ALSO DONE THIS ROUND, both pushed:
- 657ee4ea8: the archive staleness monitor is WIRED and can now fire. It went into public-surface-truth rather than a heartbeat route because that route already aggregates freshness readings and already carries an odds-inserting-freshness entry. Additive only (148 insertions, 0 deletions), fail-closed on every absence path, thresholds passed explicitly because the assessor refuses to default them. Non-vacuity PROVED by injection: corrupting the stale threshold fails the suite, restoring it returns 15/15. The tests drive the real reader and real assessor through a db delegate rather than mocking the module.
- b89e20436: all three CLV rates surfaced with their own denominators (decided 0.4084 n 901, all-graded 0.2319 n 1587, push 0.4323 n 1587). It settles NOTHING, by design. A directive asked me to write that the engine is 'only 11.6 points short, not a hopeless 29.2 point gap'. That picks the flattering reading of a question nobody has established, so both readings ship with denominators and the founder decides.

NUMBER DISCREPANCY to reconcile: the directive cites 370/911 and 370/1616; I measured 368/901 and 368/1587 by read-only SELECT. 29 rows apart, most likely a later snapshot or a different filter. Whoever owns the other figure please state its predicate. I pinned my own measured counts because those are what I observed.
